description: This file defines a security-related utility function for enforcing API key requirements on API endpoints within a FastAPI application. It imports necessary modules, retrieves configuration settings, and raises HTTP exceptions if API key validation fails.

methods.name: None require_api_key(x_api_key: str | None = Header(default=None))
methods.description: A function that enforces the presence and validity of an API key in the request header for protected endpoints.
